packages.name: FastWan 2.2 5B
packages.description: Fast text/image-to-video and stills: 3 steps with the tiny decoder. About 1.5 min for a 9-frame 1280x704 clip on a 16-core CPU.

notes: Fast Wan 2.2 distillation: 3 steps with CFG 1 and the LCM sampler (the guide includes its tuned sigmas).
Makes video, or a still image with Image selected. 1280x704 is the native size; Small halves the pixels.

packages.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
packages.description: The full Wan 2.2 5B model with its own VAE: 20 steps with CFG. Slow, best Wan detail.

notes: The full Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B: 20 steps with CFG 5 and flow shift 5. Slow on a CPU, but the most detail of the Wan models.
Uses the full Wan 2.2 VAE. For a much faster decode, pick the Tiny decoder (taew2_2 from the FastWan package) instead.

packages.name: Wan 2.2 T2V A14B
packages.description: The large Wan 2.2 text-to-video model (Q4_K_M): two 14B experts, one for the rough layout and one for detail. Best Wan quality, slowest.

notes: Two experts of about 9.7 GB each; with memory mapping they fit in 32 GB of RAM. 14B on a CPU is slow.
Starts at 832x480. Wan 2.2 A14B uses the Wan 2.1 VAE (not the 5B model's Wan 2.2 VAE).
Uses the Wan 2.1 VAE; pick the Tiny decoder (taew2_1, included) in the variant for a much faster, slightly softer decode.

packages.name: Wan 2.2 I2V A14B
packages.description: The large Wan 2.2 image-to-video model (Q4_K_M, two experts). Also takes an end frame.

notes: Two experts of about 9.7 GB each; with memory mapping they fit in 32 GB of RAM.
Pick Image → video and add a start image (and optionally an end frame).
Uses the Wan 2.1 VAE; pick the Tiny decoder (taew2_1, included) in the variant for a much faster, slightly softer decode.

packages.name: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B
packages.description: Speech to video (lip sync, Q4_K_M): a portrait talks along to your audio clip.

notes: Pick Speech → video, add a portrait and an audio clip, and set Length to the clip's length.
The output plays at 16 fps. The clip itself is silent; the speech is not mixed into the video.
14B on a CPU is slow: expect tens of minutes for a short 480p clip. Q4_K_M keeps the file near 10 GB so it fits in 32 GB of RAM.

packages.name: Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B
packages.description: Small, quick Wan 2.1 text-to-video at 480p. Good for trying prompts before a bigger model.

notes: Wan 2.1 1.3B: 20 steps with CFG 5. Made for 832x480.
Uses the Wan 2.1 VAE; pick the Tiny decoder (taew2_1, included) in the variant for a much faster, slightly softer decode.

packages.name: Wan 2.1 T2V 14B
packages.description: The large Wan 2.1 text-to-video model (Q4_K_M): much better motion and detail than 1.3B, much slower.

notes: 14B on a CPU is slow: expect tens of minutes for a short 480p clip. Q4_K_M keeps the file near 10 GB so it fits in 32 GB of RAM.
Starts at 832x480; 1280x720 also works but takes about 2.5 times longer.
Uses the Wan 2.1 VAE; pick the Tiny decoder (taew2_1, included) in the variant for a much faster, slightly softer decode.

packages.name: Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B
packages.description: Character → video (keep a person or object from a picture) and video → video (follow a control video), small and quick.

notes: Character → video: add the picture of the person or object to keep. Video → video: add a control video (pose, depth or a clip).
VACE encodes the reference with the VAE, so keep the full Wan 2.1 VAE selected.
Uses the Wan 2.1 VAE; pick the Tiny decoder (taew2_1, included) in the variant for a much faster, slightly softer decode.

packages.name: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B
packages.description: The large VACE model (Q4_K_M): character → video and video → video with better quality, much slower.

notes: 14B on a CPU is slow: expect tens of minutes for a short 480p clip. Q4_K_M keeps the file near 10 GB so it fits in 32 GB of RAM.
Character → video: add the picture of the person or object to keep. Video → video: add a control video.

packages.name: Kandinsky 6.0 Lite
packages.description: Distilled text-to-video, 10 steps. Includes the TAEHV tiny decoder (fast) and the HunyuanVideo VAE (sharp). The transformer is packed to Q8_0; the Qwen text encoder stays bf16 on machines with 48 GB RAM or more, otherwise it is packed to Q8_0.

notes: Distilled Kandinsky 6.0 Lite: 10 steps, CFG 1, Euler sampler with the PiFlow scheduler.
Needs both text encoders: the Qwen 2.5 VL 7B encoder and CLIP-L.
Decoder: TAEHV decodes in seconds; the HunyuanVideo VAE is sharper but takes much longer. Pick one (TAEHV wins when both are set).
Single frames are noisy with this model, so Image mode renders 5 frames and keeps the middle one.

packages.name: Kandinsky 6.0 Lite (full, CFG)
packages.description: The non-distilled Kandinsky 6.0 Lite: 50 Euler steps with CFG 5, so about ten times slower than Lite distill. Shares the text encoders and decoders with the Lite package. The transformer is packed to Q8_0; the Qwen text encoder stays bf16 on machines with 48 GB RAM or more, otherwise it is packed to Q8_0.

notes: Non-distilled Kandinsky 6.0 Lite: 50 steps, CFG 5, Euler sampler with the discrete scheduler. Every step runs the model twice (prompt and negative prompt).
An empty negative prompt is replaced by the release's default negative prompt, as in the official pipeline.
Needs both text encoders: the Qwen 2.5 VL 7B encoder and CLIP-L.
Decoder: TAEHV decodes in seconds; the HunyuanVideo VAE is sharper but takes much longer. Pick one (TAEHV wins when both are set).
Single frames are noisy with this model, so Image mode renders 5 frames and keeps the middle one.

packages.name: Kandinsky 6.0 Pro Distill
packages.description: Distilled Kandinsky 6.0 Pro (29B parameters): 10 PiFlow steps without CFG, about ten times slower than Lite distill on CPU. Downloading needs a 60 GB staging copy of the bf16 transformer, which is packed to Q8_0 (32 GB) on machines with 48 GB RAM or more, otherwise to Q4_K (17 GB). Shares the text encoders and decoders with the Lite package.

notes: Distilled Kandinsky 6.0 Pro: 10 steps, CFG 1, Euler sampler with the PiFlow scheduler.
Q8_0 is within 1% of the bf16 model; Q4_K, used below 48 GB RAM, differs by about 5% but fits in RAM with room for the rest of the pipeline.
Needs both text encoders: the Qwen 2.5 VL 7B encoder and CLIP-L.
Decoder: TAEHV decodes in seconds; the HunyuanVideo VAE is sharper but takes much longer. Pick one (TAEHV wins when both are set).
Single frames are noisy with this model, so Image mode renders 5 frames and keeps the middle one.

packages.name: LightX2V 4-step (T2V) LoRA
packages.description: Makes Wan 2.2 T2V A14B in 4 steps instead of 20+: about 5 times less GPU time. For Wan 2.2 T2V A14B.

notes: Speed-up LoRA: set Steps to 4 and CFG to 1 under Advanced. Use the high-noise file on the high-noise expert and the low-noise file on the low-noise expert.
Strength 1 is the usual starting point; lower it if the effect is too strong.
